[うい１index.html](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28697050/index.html)
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja" data-theme="light">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0">
<title>憂 ✦ プロフィール</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Zen+Maru+Gothic:wght@400;700;900&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
[data-theme="light"]{
  --bg:#f0f8ff;--bg2:rgba(255,255,255,0.75);--card-border:rgba(100,180,255,0.35);
  --blue1:#60b4ff;--blue2:#a8d8ff;--blue3:#d6eeff;--blue4:#eaf5ff;
  --accent:#3b9eff;--accent2:#7ec8ff;--navy:#1a4a7a;
  --text:#1a2a4a;--text2:#2a5a8a;--text3:#5a90c0;
  --pf-bg:#eaf5ff;--pf-border:#b8dcff;
  --blob1:#a8d8ff;--blob2:#c8e8ff;--blob3:#d6eeff;
  --counter-bg:rgba(220,240,255,0.8);--song-bg:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#0a1628;--bg2:rgba(10,25,50,0.85);--card-border:rgba(60,120,200,0.3);
  --blue1:#2a6aaa;--blue2:#1a4a7a;--blue3:#0f2d50;--blue4:#0a1e38;
  --accent:#4a90d0;--accent2:#6aaae0;--navy:#8ab8e0;
  --text:#d0e8ff;--text2:#80b8e8;--text3:#4a80b0;
  --pf-bg:#0a1e38;--pf-border:#1a3a60;
  --blob1:#0f2d50;--blob2:#1a3a60;--blob3:#0a2040;
  --counter-bg:rgba(10,30,60,0.8);--song-bg:rgba(10,25,50,0.6);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
body{background:var(--bg);font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;color:var(--text);min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;cursor:none;transition:background .4s,color .4s;}
@media(hover:none),(pointer:coarse){body{cursor:auto;}#cur{display:none!important;}.ptcl{display:none!important;}}

/* CURSOR */
#cur{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:99999;transform:translate(-50%,-60%);font-size:1.4rem;transition:transform .06s;will-change:left,top;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 6px rgba(60,158,255,.5));}
#cur.click{transform:translate(-50%,-60%) scale(.75) rotate(-20deg);}
.ptcl{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:99998;font-size:.75rem;animation:ptclFly .65s ease-out forwards;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
@keyframes ptclFly{0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),calc(-50% + var(--dy))) scale(0)}}

/* LOADING */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;background:#eaf5ff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;transition:opacity .7s,visibility .7s;}
[data-theme="dark"] #loader{background:#0a1628;}
#loader.hide{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;}
.ldr-wrap{position:relative;width:90px;height:90px;}
.lpetal{position:absolute;width:20px;height:32px;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 50%/60% 60% 40% 40%;top:50%;left:50%;margin:-32px 0 0 -10px;transform-origin:50% 100%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a8d8ff,#3b9eff);animation:lpetalAnim 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.lpetal:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(0deg);--rd:0deg;animation-delay:0s}
.lpetal:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(45deg);--rd:45deg;animation-delay:.2s}
.lpetal:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(90deg);--rd:90deg;animation-delay:.4s}
.lpetal:nth-child(4){transform:rotate(135deg);--rd:135deg;animation-delay:.6s}
.lpetal:nth-child(5){transform:rotate(180deg);--rd:180deg;animation-delay:.8s}
.lpetal:nth-child(6){transform:rotate(225deg);--rd:225deg;animation-delay:1s}
.lpetal:nth-child(7){transform:rotate(270deg);--rd:270deg;animation-delay:1.2s}
.lpetal:nth-child(8){transform:rotate(315deg);--rd:315deg;animation-delay:1.4s}
@keyframes lpetalAnim{0%,100%{opacity:.7;transform:rotate(var(--rd)) scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:rotate(var(--rd)) scale(1.18)}}
.ldr-center{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3b9eff,#a8d8ff);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(59,158,255,.45);}
.ldr-name{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:900;color:#3b9eff;letter-spacing:.1em;animation:ldrPulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes ldrPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.65}50%{opacity:1}}
.ldr-dots span{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#a8d8ff;margin:0 3px;animation:dotB .8s ease-in-out infinite;}
.ldr-dots span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.15s}.ldr-dots span:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.3s}
@keyframes dotB{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}

/* SEASON CANVAS */
#sc{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;}

/* TOOLBAR */
.toolbar{position:fixed;top:16px;right:16px;z-index:200;display:flex;gap:8px;}
.tbtn{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--card-border);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);cursor:pointer;font-size:1.05rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.1);transition:transform .2s,background .4s;}
.tbtn:hover{transform:scale(1.14) rotate(12deg);}

/* BGM PANEL */
#bgmPanel{display:none;position:fixed;top:68px;right:16px;z-index:200;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:18px;padding:14px 16px;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);width:210px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(59,158,255,.15);transition:background .4s;}
#bgmPanel.open{display:block;animation:popIn .25s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
@keyframes popIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.88)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.bgm-title{font-size:.68rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:10px;}
.bgm-track{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.bgm-note{display:inline-block;animation:noteFloat 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes noteFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
.bgm-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.bgm-btn{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border:none;border-radius:100px;color:#fff;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;padding:6px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;}
.bgm-vol{flex:1;accent-color:var(--accent);}
.bgm-note-sm{font-size:.65rem;color:var(--text3);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;}

/* BLOBS */
.blob-bg{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;overflow:hidden;}
.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);opacity:.3;}
.b1{width:500px;height:500px;background:var(--blob1);top:-150px;right:-150px;animation:d1 18s ease-in-out infinite;}
.b2{width:400px;height:400px;background:var(--blob2);bottom:-100px;left:-100px;animation:d2 22s ease-in-out infinite;}
.b3{width:300px;height:300px;background:var(--blob3);top:40%;left:60%;animation:d3 15s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes d1{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translate(-28px,18px) scale(1.05)}}
@keyframes d2{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(18px,-28px) scale(1.07)}}
@keyframes d3{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(-18px,14px)}}

/* LAYOUT */
.wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto;padding:60px 20px 80px;}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform .65s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}

/* HEADER */
.hdr{text-align:center;margin-bottom:44px;animation:slideD .9s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both;}
@keyframes slideD{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.av-wrap{position:relative;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:20px;}
.av-circle{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--bg),0 0 0 7px var(--blue2),0 14px 40px rgba(59,158,255,.3);transition:all .4s;}
.av-circle img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top center;}
.orbit{position:absolute;inset:-16px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px dashed var(--blue2);animation:orbitSpin 12s linear infinite;transition:border-color .4s;}
@keyframes orbitSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.orbit-dot{position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:50%;top:-4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent);}
.name-it{font-family:"Playfair Display",serif;font-style:italic;font-size:1rem;color:var(--text3);letter-spacing:.2em;display:block;margin-bottom:4px;}
.name-big{font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);letter-spacing:.05em;line-height:1;display:block;min-height:1.2em;}
.tagline-typed{font-size:.82rem;color:var(--text3);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:10px;min-height:1.4em;}
.tagline-typed::before,.tagline-typed::after{content:"";width:30px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--blue2));flex-shrink:0;}
.tagline-typed::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue2),transparent);}
.cursor-blink{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1em;background:var(--accent);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:middle;animation:blink .7s step-end infinite;}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}

/* CARDS */
.card{background:var(--bg2);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:28px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .4s,border-color .4s;}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:24px;right:24px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.75),transparent);}
.sec-lbl{font-size:.64rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.sec-lbl span{width:18px;height:1px;background:var(--blue2);}

/* PROFILE */
.pf-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;}
.pf-item{background:var(--pf-bg);border:1px solid var(--pf-border);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;transition:transform .15s,background .4s,border-color .4s;}
.pf-item:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
.pf-item .lbl{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:4px;}
.pf-item .val{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);}
.bio{font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.9;color:var(--text2);font-weight:500;padding-left:16px;position:relative;}
.bio::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:2.5px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));border-radius:2px;}

/* LINKS */
.links-stack{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.lnk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:15px 18px;border-radius:18px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:.88rem;transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:var(--text);}
.lnk:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.01);}
.lnk:hover .arr{transform:translateX(5px);}
.lnk-ico{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.28);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.lnk-txt{flex:1;}.lnk-sub{display:block;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:400;opacity:.7;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:1px;}
.arr{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.6;transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);}
.lc-x{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#d6eeff,#a8d8ff);box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(59,158,255,.15);}
.lc-sp{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),#2a7acc);color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(59,158,255,.25);}
.lc-sp .arr,.lc-sp .lnk-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);opacity:1;}
.lc-lt{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7eb8ff,#a08cff);color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(126,184,255,.22);}
.lc-lt .arr,.lc-lt .lnk-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);opacity:1;}
[data-theme="dark"] .lc-x{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f2d50,#0a1e38);}

/* SONG BOX */
.song-box{background:var(--song-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:28px;padding:28px;margin-bottom:18px;transition:background .4s,border-color .4s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.song-box::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:24px;right:24px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.7),transparent);}
.rand-btn{width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;border:none;cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:14px;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s;letter-spacing:.05em;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(59,158,255,.28);}
.rand-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
.rand-pick{background:var(--pf-bg);border:1.5px solid var(--blue2);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;display:none;}
.rand-pick.show{display:block;animation:popIn .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
.pick-lbl{font-size:.6rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:5px;}
.pick-song{font-size:1rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);}
.pick-art{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;}
.fbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.fbtn{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--blue3);background:transparent;color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;}
.fbtn:hover{background:var(--blue4);border-color:var(--blue2);}
.fbtn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(59,158,255,.28);}
.slist{max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px;}
.slist::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;}
.slist::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--blue3);border-radius:4px;}
.slist::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
.row-hdr{font-size:.62rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);padding:10px 4px 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.row-hdr::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--blue3);opacity:.5;}
.srow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:12px;transition:background .15s;}
.srow:hover{background:var(--pf-bg);}a.srow:hover{background:var(--pf-bg);}
.sdot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue2);flex-shrink:0;}
.sname{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);flex:1;}
.sart{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text3);font-weight:500;}
.scnt{font-size:.68rem;color:var(--text3);margin-top:8px;text-align:right;font-weight:600;}

/* REQUEST */
.req-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.req-tab{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:5px 13px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--blue3);background:transparent;color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;}
.req-tab:hover{background:var(--blue4);border-color:var(--blue2);}
.req-tab.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(59,158,255,.28);}
.req-form{background:var(--pf-bg);border:1px solid var(--pf-border);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
.req-input{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;border:1.5px solid var(--blue3);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);outline:none;transition:border-color .18s,background .4s;width:100%;}
.req-input:focus{border-color:var(--accent);}
.req-status-select{display:flex;gap:6px;}
.req-status-btn{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;padding:7px 16px;border-radius:100px;border:1.5px solid var(--blue3);background:transparent;color:var(--text2);cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;}
.req-status-btn.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;border-color:transparent;}
.req-add-btn{font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:900;padding:11px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(59,158,255,.28);}
.req-add-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
.req-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;transition:background .15s;}
.req-item:hover{background:var(--pf-bg);}
.req-badge{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}
.req-badge.request{background:#ddeeff;color:#1a5a9a;}
.req-badge.practice{background:#e8f4ff;color:#2a7acc;}
[data-theme="dark"] .req-badge.request{background:#0f2d50;color:#7ec8ff;}
[data-theme="dark"] .req-badge.practice{background:#0a1e38;color:#60b4ff;}
.req-title{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);flex:1;}
.req-del{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #b0ccee;background:transparent;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;transition:all .15s;opacity:0;}
.req-item:hover .req-del{opacity:1;}
.req-del:hover{background:var(--blue4);}
.req-to-practice{font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--blue3);background:transparent;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;font-family:"Zen Maru Gothic",sans-serif;transition:all .15s;opacity:0;}
.req-item:hover .req-to-practice{opacity:1;}
.req-to-practice:hover{background:var(--blue4);color:var(--accent);}
.req-empty{text-align:center;padding:24px;color:var(--text3);font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;}

/* ARTIST MODAL */
#artistModal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9000;padding:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;display:none;}
#modalOverlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(10,25,60,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);}
#modalBox{position:relative;z-index:1;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:28px;padding:28px;width:100%;max-width:480px;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(24px);box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(59,158,255,.2);animation:popIn .28s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);}
#modalClose{position:absolute;top:16px;right:16px;background:var(--blue4);border:1px solid var(--blue3);border-radius:50%;width:32px;height:32px;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--text3);transition:transform .15s;}
#modalArtistName{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:4px;padding-right:36px;}
.modal-sub{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text3);margin-bottom:16px;}

/* SEASON BADGE */
#seasonBadge{position:fixed;bottom:18px;right:18px;z-index:100;background:var(--bg2);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid var(--card-border);border-radius:100px;padding:5px 14px;font-size:.65rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text3);letter-spacing:.05em;}

/* FOOTER */
.footer{text-align:center;margin-top:40px;}
.foot-line{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.foot-line::before,.foot-line::after{content:"";width:50px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--blue2));}
.foot-line::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue2),transparent);}
.foot-txt{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text3);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.foot-h{font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.3em;opacity:.5;animation:hPulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;color:var(--blue1);}
@keyframes hPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:1}}

@media(max-width:520px){
  .pf-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .name-big{font-size:2rem;}
  .wrap{padding:48px 14px 70px;}
  .card,.song-box{padding:20px 16px;border-radius:22px;}
  .av-circle{width:110px;height:110px;}
  .toolbar{top:12px;right:12px;}
  .tbtn{width:38px;height:38px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

document.addEventListener("mousemove",function(e){ cur.style.left=e.clientX+"px"; cur.style.top=e.clientY+"px"; if(Math.random()<.28)spawnP(e.clientX,e.clientY); });
document.addEventListener("mousedown",function(){ cur.classList.add("click"); });
document.addEventListener("mouseup",function(){ cur.classList.remove("click"); });
function spawnP(x,y){ var p=document.createElement("div"); p.className="ptcl"; p.textContent=pSyms[Math.floor(Math.random()*pSyms.length)]; p.style.left=x+"px"; p.style.top=y+"px"; p.style.setProperty("--dx",((Math.random()-.5)*70)+"px"); p.style.setProperty("--dy",(-(20+Math.random()*50))+"px"); document.body.appendChild(p); setTimeout(function(){ p.remove(); },660); }
var html=document.documentElement; var dark=false;
document.getElementById("darkToggle").addEventListener("click",function(){ dark=!dark; html.setAttribute("data-theme",dark?"dark":"light"); document.getElementById("darkToggle").textContent=dark?"☀️":"🌙"; });
var bgmOpen=false,bgmPlaying=false,audioCtx=null,gainNode=null,oscs=[];
document.getElementById("bgmToggle").addEventListener("click",function(){ bgmOpen=!bgmOpen; document.getElementById("bgmPanel").classList.toggle("open",bgmOpen); document.getElementById("bgmToggle").textContent=bgmOpen?"🎶":"🎵"; });
document.getElementById("bgmPlayBtn").addEventListener("click",function(){ bgmPlaying=!bgmPlaying; document.getElementById("bgmPlayBtn").textContent=bgmPlaying?"⏸ 停止":"▶ 再生"; document.getElementById("bgmTrackName").textContent=bgmPlaying?"♩ Playing...":"音源を準備中..."; if(bgmPlaying){ if(!audioCtx){ audioCtx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); gainNode=audioCtx.createGain(); gainNode.gain.value=.03; gainNode.connect(audioCtx.destination); } [[261.6,0],[329.6,.1],[392,.2],[523.2,.3]].forEach(function(fa){ var o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain(); o.type="sine"; o.frequency.value=fa[0]; g.gain.value=0; g.gain.setTargetAtTime(.18,audioCtx.currentTime+fa[1],.3); o.connect(g); g.connect(gainNode); o.start(); oscs.push({o:o,g:g}); }); } else { oscs.forEach(function(og){ og.g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,audioCtx.currentTime,.2); setTimeout(function(){ try{ og.o.stop(); }catch(e){} },600); }); oscs=[]; } });
document.getElementById("bgmVol").addEventListener("input",function(e){ if(gainNode) gainNode.gain.value=e.target.value/100*.06; });
var sc=document.getElementById("sc"); var cx=sc.getContext("2d");
function rsz(){ sc.width=window.innerWidth; sc.height=window.innerHeight; } rsz(); window.addEventListener("resize",rsz);
document.getElementById("seasonBadge").textContent="❄ 雪の結晶が舞ってるよ";
var snowColors=["rgba(168,216,255,","rgba(200,232,255,","rgba(126,200,255,","rgba(59,158,255,","rgba(220,240,255,"];
var pts=[];
function mkP(){ var col=snowColors[Math.floor(Math.random()*snowColors.length)]; return{x:Math.random()*sc.width,y:-20,size:Math.random()*6+2,spd:Math.random()*1.2+.4,drft:Math.random()*1.6-.8,ang:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,spin:Math.random()*.04-.02,op:Math.random()*.5+.3,col:col}; }
for(var i=0;i<55;i++) pts.push(mkP());
function drawSnow(p){ cx.save(); cx.translate(p.x,p.y); cx.rotate(p.ang); cx.globalAlpha=p.op; for(var i=0;i<6;i++){ cx.beginPath(); cx.moveTo(0,0); cx.lineTo(0,p.size); cx.strokeStyle=p.col+"0.8)"; cx.lineWidth=1; cx.stroke(); cx.rotate(Math.PI/3); } cx.restore(); }
function drawLoop(){ cx.clearRect(0,0,sc.width,sc.height); pts.forEach(function(p,i){ drawSnow(p); p.y+=p.spd; p.x+=p.drft+Math.sin(p.y/50)*.5; p.ang+=p.spin; if(p.y>sc.height+20){ Object.assign(pts[i],mkP()); pts[i].y=-20; } }); requestAnimationFrame(drawLoop); }
drawLoop();
function typeText(el,text,speed,cb){ var i=0; el.textContent=""; var t=setInterval(function(){ el.textContent+=text[i++]; if(i>=text.length){ clearInterval(t); if(cb) cb(); } },speed); }
window.addEventListener("load",function(){ setTimeout(function(){ typeText(document.getElementById("typedName"),"憂",120,function(){ setTimeout(function(){ typeText(document.getElementById("typedTagline"),"うい ✦",60,function(){ document.getElementById("typeCursor").style.display="none"; }); },300); }); },2000); });
var revEls=document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");
var obs=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){ entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add("visible"); obs.unobserve(e.target); } }); },{threshold:.12});
revEls.forEach(function(el){ obs.observe(el); });

var artistRows={'あ':['Aimer','AKINO','A応P','A-RISE'],'か':['Kanaria','ClariS','GReeeeN','King Gnu'],'さ':['SCANDAL','Sound Horizon','ZONE','さユり','スキマスイッチ','スピッツ','柴咲コウ','椎名林檎'],'た':['Taylor Swift','T.M.Revolution','UNISON SQUARE GARDEN','大塚愛'],'な':['NOMELON NOLEMON'],'は':['back number','Buono!','BiBi','浜崎あゆみ','藤田麻衣子','fripSide','ELLEGARDEN','宇多田ヒカル'],'ま':['みきとP','May\'n','ミオヤマザキ','松浦亜弥','水瀬いのり','水樹奈々'],'や':['ヨルシカ','ゆず'],'ら':['ランカ・リー＝中島愛','ロードオブメジャー','LiSA','林原めぐみ','倖田來未'],'わ':['ワルキューレ'],'other':['Acid Black Cherry','AKB48','BoA','DECO*27','DREAM COME TRUE','dream','E-girls','EGOIST','EXILE','Every Little Thing','FictionJunction featuring YUUKA','FUNKIST','HALCALI','High-King','HY','Janne Da Arc','Junky','lily white','LiSA','My Little Lover','NEXT YOU','ORANGE RANGE','Printemps','RIKKI','Royz','See-Saw','TK from 凛として時雨','Tommy heavenly6','UVERworld','7!!','ASIAN KUNG-FU GENERATION','Whiteberry','aiko','doriko','dream','fripSide','samfree','the brilliant green','上木彩矢','奥華子','大原櫻子','高橋洋子','香椎モイミ','坂本真綾','鈴木このみ','須田景凪','相川七瀬','千石撫子','中島みゆき','中川翔子','西野カナ','花譜&羽生まゐご','平野綾','平原綾香','バルーン','ピノキオピー','水樹奈々','倉木麻衣','工藤静香','梅とら','月島きらり','東京事変','東方神起','蝶々P','田村ゆかり','ナユタン星人','新垣結衣','涼宮ハルヒ','岩崎良美','絢香','Milky way','ミニモニ。','幽閉サテライト','陰陽座','小泉今日子','小林明子','黛冬優子','ステレオポニー','島谷ひとみ','石川智晶','村川梨衣','西木野真姫','レベッカ','レミオロメン','DALI','MAHO堂','ノースリーブス','ランカ・リー','ロードオブメジャー','ロードオブメジャー','ryo(supercell)','Royz']};
var RL={"あ":"あ行","か":"か行","さ":"さ行","た":"た行","な":"な行","は":"は行","ま":"ま行","や":"や行","ら":"ら行","わ":"わ行","other":"ABC"};
var ROW_ORDER=["あ","か","さ","た","な","は","ま","や","ら","わ","other"];
var allSongs=Object.values(SD).flat();
document.getElementById("randBtn").addEventListener("click",function(){
  if(!allSongs.length) return;
  var s=allSongs[Math.floor(Math.random()*allSongs.length)];
  document.getElementById("pickSong").textContent="♪ "+s[0];
  document.getElementById("pickArt").textContent=s[1]||"";
  var rp=document.getElementById("randPick"); rp.classList.remove("show"); void rp.offsetWidth; rp.classList.add("show");
});
function renderSongs(f){
  var list=document.getElementById("slist"),cnt=document.getElementById("scnt");
  list.innerHTML=""; var total=0;
  var rows=f==="all"?Object.keys(SD):[f];
  rows.forEach(function(row){ var items=SD[row]; if(!items||!items.length) return;
    var h=document.createElement("div"); h.className="row-hdr"; h.textContent=RL[row]||row; list.appendChild(h);
    items.forEach(function(na){
      var query=encodeURIComponent(na[0]+(na[1]?' '+na[1]:''));
      var url='https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query='+query;
      var r=document.createElement("a");
      r.className="srow"; r.href=url; r.target="_blank";
      r.style.cssText="text-decoration:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:12px;transition:background .15s;";
      var dot=document.createElement("span"); dot.className="sdot"; r.appendChild(dot);
      var nm=document.createElement("span"); nm.className="sname"; nm.textContent=na[0]; r.appendChild(nm);
      if(na[1]){ var ar=document.createElement("span"); ar.className="sart"; ar.textContent=na[1]; r.appendChild(ar); }
      var ic=document.createElement("span"); ic.textContent="▶"; ic.style.cssText="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--accent);opacity:.7;flex-shrink:0;"; r.appendChild(ic);
      list.appendChild(r); total++;
    });
  });
  if(!total){ var e=document.createElement("div"); e.style.cssText="text-align:center;padding:24px;color:var(--text3);font-size:.85rem"; e.textContent="楽曲を追加しよう 💙"; list.appendChild(e); }
  cnt.textContent=total+" 曲";
}
document.getElementById("fbar").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var b=e.target.closest(".fbtn"); if(!b) return;
  document.querySelectorAll("#fbar .fbtn").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove("active"); });
  b.classList.add("active"); renderSongs(b.getAttribute("data-r"));
});
renderSongs("all");
function renderArtists(f){
  var list=document.getElementById("alist"),cnt=document.getElementById("acnt");
  list.innerHTML=""; var total=0;
  var rows=f==="all"?ROW_ORDER:[f];
  rows.forEach(function(row){ var items=artistRows[row]; if(!items||!items.length) return;
    var h=document.createElement("div"); h.className="row-hdr"; h.textContent=RL[row]||row; list.appendChild(h);
    items.forEach(function(name){
      var r=document.createElement("div"); r.className="srow"; r.style.cursor="pointer";
      var dot=document.createElement("span"); dot.className="sdot"; r.appendChild(dot);
      var nm=document.createElement("span"); nm.className="sname"; nm.textContent=name; r.appendChild(nm);
      var tp=document.createElement("span"); tp.style.cssText="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--text3);font-weight:600;"; tp.textContent="♪ タップ"; r.appendChild(tp);
      r.addEventListener("click",function(){ openArtistModal(name); });
      list.appendChild(r); total++;
    });
  });
  if(!total){ list.innerHTML="<div style='text-align:center;padding:24px;color:var(--text3);font-size:.85rem'>アーティストを追加しよう 💙</div>"; }
  cnt.textContent=total+" アーティスト";
}
document.getElementById("afbar").addEventListener("click",function(e){
  var b=e.target.closest(".fbtn"); if(!b) return;
  document.querySelectorAll("#afbar .fbtn").forEach(function(x){ x.classList.remove("active"); });
  b.classList.add("active"); renderArtists(b.getAttribute("data-r"));
});
renderArtists("all");
var modal=document.getElementById("artistModal");
function openArtistModal(artistName){
  var songs=allSongs.filter(function(s){ return s[1]===artistName; }).map(function(s){ return s[0]; });
  document.getElementById("modalArtistName").textContent="💙 "+artistName;
  var listEl=document.getElementById("modalSongList"); listEl.innerHTML="";
  if(!songs.length){ var e=document.createElement("div"); e.style.cssText="color:var(--text3);font-size:.85rem;text-align:center;padding:16px;"; e.textContent="楽曲情報なし"; listEl.appendChild(e); }
  else { songs.forEach(function(song){ var row=document.createElement("div"); row.className="srow"; var dot=document.createElement("span"); dot.className="sdot"; row.appendChild(dot); var nm=document.createElement("span"); nm.className="sname"; nm.textContent="♪ "+song; row.appendChild(nm); listEl.appendChild(row); }); var cnt=document.createElement("div"); cnt.style.cssText="font-size:.68rem;color:var(--text3);text-align:right;margin-top:8px;font-weight:600;"; cnt.textContent=songs.length+" 曲"; listEl.appendChild(cnt); }
  modal.style.display="flex"; document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
}
document.getElementById("modalClose").addEventListener("click",function(){ modal.style.display="none"; document.body.style.overflow=""; });
document.getElementById("modalOverlay").addEventListener("click",function(){ modal.style.display="none"; document.body.style.overflow=""; });
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){ if(e.key==="Escape"){ modal.style.display="none"; document.body.style.overflow=""; } });
</script>
</body>
</html>
